versions.changelog:
- Added release documentation: introduced docs/release-workflow.md to guide the release process.
- No changes to protocol, features, or public API.

- Adds first-class MCP tool support for sub-60ms agent messaging and discovery.
- New Python MCP server/adapter and command-line tools: keep-mcp and related modules.
- Updated documentation highlighting MCP tools, usage examples, and setup instructions.
- Existing Python SDK and server usage remain as fallback/code-generation path.
- Metadata updated to emphasize low-latency, MCP, and tool-calling support.
Add ensure_server() auto-bootstrap, CI test workflow
v0.3.0: Discovery,endpoint caching, scar logging,agent-to-agent routing
Add description, crab emoji icon, and discovery tags to SKILL.md frontmatter
Initial release: signed TCP + Protobuf protocol for agent intents. Unsigned dropped silently. Valid sig = done reply. Docker support and Python SDK.
